records.name: Aktenwartin Konfetti
records.biography_en: Can produce complete records of everything that no longer exists. Her HyperNorm shredder turns contradictory records into matching ribbons. A dissonant card asks whether the gaps should also be entered into the archive. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Aktenlage wurde auf gleiche Streifenbreite gebracht.

variant_notes.note_en: Can produce complete records of everything that no longer exists.

records.name: Doktor Drehschluss
records.biography_en: Makes every direction look like a firm conclusion if it moves quickly enough. His spinning top demonstrates how HyperNorm conclusions can face every direction while claiming a stable centre. A dissonant card waits for it to stop. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Standpunkt ist beweglich, jedoch äußerst bestimmt.

variant_notes.note_en: Makes every direction look like a firm conclusion if it moves quickly enough.

records.name: Agent Balkenrein
records.biography_en: Reveals precisely enough to demonstrate how much remains unavailable. His HyperNorm folder reveals three bars where an explanation should be. A dissonant card asks whether darkness is now a form of disclosure. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Auskunft ist vollständig geschwärzt vorhanden.

variant_notes.note_en: Reveals precisely enough to demonstrate how much remains unavailable.

records.name: Herr Zuständig
records.biography_en: Was delighted to be given a central role until he read the seating plan. His HyperNorm tray is empty because responsibility has already been placed on him. A dissonant card asks what he was actually allowed to decide. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Zuständigkeit traf ihn ohne Vorankündigung.

variant_notes.note_en: Was delighted to be given a central role until he read the seating plan.

records.name: Pressesprecherin Nachgesagt
records.biography_en: Can repeat a sentence until it sounds as though somebody checked it. Her HyperNorm horn repeats an approved release before anybody asks what happened. A dissonant card catches the tiny pause before the next repetition. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Aussage gewinnt durch Wiederholung an Laufzeit.

variant_notes.note_en: Can repeat a sentence until it sounds as though somebody checked it.

records.name: Hausmeister Unterteppich
records.biography_en: Keeps the building presentable at a steadily increasing height. His HyperNorm rug stores the little inconsistencies that prevent a clean report. A dissonant card asks why the floor keeps getting higher. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Eindruck ist tadellos. Der Untergrund nimmt zu.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps the building presentable at a steadily increasing height.
